items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-16
items.q: Mr. Adam Lynch, newscaster, TV personality and classical music broadcaster.

ctx.x: Educational television plants the seeds of future careers in the young. It cultivates and refreshes the intellect of the adult. It enriches the leisure time of the senior citizen who wants never to stop learning. Contribute to the support of your community station. Send your contribution to WYES-TV, Channel 8, New Orleans 24. The End To open the doors to richness in our lives, we each may choose the best of what has gone before, the best of that which lives today, to fashion us a seed. And from the minds of those…
You hear so much about the Roaring Twenties, I didn't live it. Could you tell me a little bit about it?
